doc.projectIntro: This quote covers the 100Mbps connectivity service for Plane Talking, paid online by card: a pro-rata portion of the current month at checkout, and the monthly fee billed automatically on the 1st of each month thereafter. The once-off network installation (rack, switch, cabling and labour) is quoted separately under QU-PLA-002. All prices exclude VAT (15%).

items.detail: 100Mbps service, billed monthly. Your first month is charged pro-rata from three days after checkout (allowing for installation); thereafter the full monthly fee is billed on the 1st.

doc.summaryNote: Checkout is online by card: you pay a pro-rata portion of the current month now, and R 1,725.00 incl VAT is then billed automatically to the same card on the 1st of every month until cancelled. The three days between checkout and the start of billing allow for installation at no charge. The once-off installation is quoted separately under QU-PLA-002.
terms: This quote is valid for 14 days from the date of issue.
All prices exclude VAT at 15% unless otherwise stated.
Payment is by card at checkout: a pro-rata charge for the current month, calculated from three days after checkout to month-end.
The monthly connectivity fee is billed automatically to the same card on the 1st of every month until cancelled.
The connectivity service is month-to-month; cancellation requires one calendar month's notice.
The once-off network installation is quoted separately under QU-PLA-002.
